portrait.reference: User-supplied portrait, used with instruction to build a personal miniature.
portrait.method: Portrait texture mapped to a measured front facial surface; side and rear volumes, hair, body, and clothes inferred.
portrait.limitations: Not a full scan or an anatomically calibrated reconstruction.

continuous_body.method: Connected remeshed arm and garment surfaces with normalized deformation weights; separate hidden compound collision geometry keeps the figure one physical object.

facial_surface_preprocessing.execution: Local preprocessing only; no runtime model or remote image request.
